title: Home guide and safety card: fruit and yoghurt pot
subject: Art & Design
unit: Spring 1: Colour mixing, food landscapes and a fruit pot (Muck, Mess & Mixtures)
source: Written for art/y2 lesson 5 (Home practical guide and safety card: fruit and yoghurt pot (portal worksheet): halal and allergy check, adult supervises cutting)
intro: Lesson 5. Make a layered fruit pot with an adult. Check every ingredient first.

practical.aim: Wash hands and make a fruit pot safely, following a layered design.
equipment: A clear cup or small pot
A table knife, a chopping board and a spoon
A bag and a rolling pin for crushing biscuits
safety: Halal check: an adult checks the yoghurt and biscuits are halal (no gelatine from pork)
Allergy check: an adult checks nobody eating it has a milk, wheat or nut allergy
An adult helps with all cutting; use a board
Wash hands for 20 seconds; tie back long hair
practical.adult: An adult supervises all cutting and checks the ingredients.
method: Say Bismillah, wash your hands and put an apron on.
Spoon yoghurt into the bottom of the pot (layer 1).
With an adult, cut the soft fruit on the board with a table knife.
Put biscuits in a bag and crush them with a rolling pin.
Sprinkle the crushed biscuit 'mud' on top (layer 3). Taste it and say Alhamdulillah.
